      Good to know

      • 1·4·7·10
        The lift is old. It only stops at storeys 1, 4, 7 and 10. Take the staircase at the east end for the other floors.
      • Follow the yellow arrow. It points to your next stop, shows how far it is, and even tells you when to take the lift or the stairs. Tap an errand in the list to switch which one it follows. A short tutorial starts the first time you play.
      • Collect 24 kueh (ondeh-ondeh, kueh lapis, ang ku kueh) and find 3 old 5¢ coins hidden around the estate.
      • Explore downstairs. Blk 87 across the plaza has a kopitiam, provision shop, 24-hour mart, barber, clinic and bakery. Ask the kopitiam uncle how to order kopi.
      • Mind the road. Buses run along Tembusu Avenue. Cross carefully at the bus stop.
      • No falling damage. Miss a jump and you just land a floor lower. Shoo birds, never hurt them.
